answer: The vertex is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the river. What survives to the nadir is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
